headline: 7-year-old kidnapped in Dhaka's Shewrapara, still missing after two days
summary: CCTV footage shows a young woman taking the child away; police are tracking the rickshaw they used to flee the scene.
details: A seven-year-old boy was kidnapped from the Shewrapara area of Kafrul Thana in Dhaka on Thursday afternoon, September 3.

caption:
A 7-year-old boy was taken by a woman in broad daylight. CCTV captured the abduction, but he remains missing.

A seven-year-old boy was kidnapped from the Shewrapara area of Kafrul Thana in Dhaka on Thursday afternoon, September 3.

CCTV footage from the scene reveals a woman, aged 20-22, wearing a black salwar-kameez, taking the child by the hand. The footage suggests the child may have known the woman.

Police have tracked the rickshaw the woman and child boarded to Agargaon, but their current location remains unknown.

Kafrul Thana OC Saifull Islam stated that no ransom demands have been made so far, leaving the motive for the abduction unknown.

Police are conducting raids in various locations, including rickshaw garages, and analyzing further CCTV footage to find the child.

According to police headquarters, between January and July this year, 474 GDs were filed for the disappearance of children aged 1-9, with 68 still missing.

In the same period, 15,243 children aged 10-17 went missing, of which 1,970 remain unrecovered.

headline_marked: 70-year-old [[woman dies after being hit by state minister’s car]] in Bogura
headline: 70-year-old woman dies after being hit by state minister’s car in Bogura
summary: The victim, Firoza Begum, died while undergoing treatment. State Minister Abdul Bari and his wife were also injured in the accident.
details: A 70-year-old woman, identified as Firoza Begum of Gopinathpur village, died after being hit by a car carrying State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari and his wife in Bogura’s Shibganj upazila.
The accident occurred around 9:00 am yesterday morning on the Bogura-Joypurhat road. Firoza was crossing the road after a police protocol van had passed when the collision occurred.
Firoza was first taken to a local clinic and then transferred to TMSS Medical College and Rafatullah Community Hospital in Bogura, where she succumbed to her injuries around 11:45 am.
The state minister's SUV swerved off the road and fell into a paddy field while attempting to avoid the woman. Abdul Bari sustained an injury to his right leg, and his wife suffered minor injuries.
The state minister was initially taken to Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital in Bogura before being sent to Dhaka for advanced treatment.

Police confirmed that no formal case has been filed regarding the accident and death, although a General Diary has been recorded. The upazila administration provided Tk 25,000 to the victim's family for burial expenses.
